description: A cheap stored-data manifest for one exact company: available datasets, latest reporting periods, actual ingestion/computation timestamps where stored, and cached relationship graph status. Call before deeper research when coverage or freshness is uncertain. This reads indexed metadata, not every research endpoint, and never starts enrichment. Availability is not completeness or accuracy. A null stored timestamp means freshness is unknown; a reporting period is not an ingestion date. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

ticker.description: Exact native Bullrun company ticker, e.g. AAPL or SAP.

name: get_company_data_coverage
title: Get company data availability and freshness
